from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCapitalRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents the capital reserve data extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as stated in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities trading code if available in the report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024 First Quarter')")
    capital_reserve_amount: float | None = Field(description="The capital reserve amount (capital 公积) in CNY")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_capital_records: list[CompanyCapitalRecord]
